defs.def: information, documents, etc. that show that sth is true 证据；证明

ex.s: In fact, more than one account suggests that while Newton was certainly inspired by a falling apple, there is no proof that it hit him on the head.
ex.t: 事实上，不止一个说法表明，虽然牛顿确实受到一个落下的苹果的启发，但没有证据证明它砸中了他的头。

ex.s: Polyglots are indeed amazing, but American teenager Tim Doner is living proof that anyone can try to be one.
ex.t: 通晓多种语言的人确实很了不起，但美国青少年蒂姆\u00b7多纳是活生生的证明，任何人都有可能尝试成为这样的人。

ex.s: It was correct, but he still needed proof.
ex.t: 这是对的，但他仍需要证据。

ex.s: There is no proof she was a real person.
ex.t: 没有证据证明她是一个真实的人。

ex.s: That's how I continue to get better every single day.” Inspiring others to believe in themselves, Stephen Curry is living proof that what other people think of you does not have to influence what you become.
ex.t: 我每天都在继续这样好转。” 激励别人相信自己，Stephen Curry是活生生的证据，证明别人对你的看法不必影响你变成什么样。

ex.s: Due to the lack of scientific proof concerning their impacts, no one has succeeded in winning a lawsuit against cloud-seeding companies.
ex.t: 由于缺乏关于其影响的科学证据，没有人成功起诉过人工降雨公司。

defs.def: the process of testing whether sth is true or a fact 检验；证实
a way of proving that a statement is true or that what you have calculated is correct 证明；求证；验算

ex.s: “Our cooperation is truly proof of what makes Salk science so special and impactful,” says Pereira.
ex.t: "我们的合作真正证明了萨尔克科学的特殊性和影响力，"佩雷拉说。

defs.def: a copy of printed material which is produced so that mistakes can be corrected 校样
a standard used to measure the strength of alcoholic drinks （酒的）标准酒精度
that can resist the damaging or harmful effects of sth 能抵御；能防范；可防护
that can resist or protect against the thing mentioned 构成复合词
to put a special substance on sth, especially cloth, to protect it against water, fire, etc. 给（织物等）做防护处理；使防水（或防火等）
to produce a test copy of a piece of printed work so that mistakes can be corrected 印 … 的校样
